description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rules of Exchange effective from 17.09.2018 to 23.09.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
